name: Beehive
startBias.startIntroPart1: Ayup, good day, Queen Bee! Your workers are ready. Let's get it going now, but don't push yourself too hard.
startBias.declaringWar: Your death will be very sweet indeed.
startBias.attacked: Is this how you treat a queen?!
neutralNo: We have come to a unanimous decision... No.
neutralYes: You would have made for a lovely worker bee!
hateNo: We are not agreeing to that!
Do I even need to say it?
startBias.afterPeace: Very well, you were losing anyway.
startBias.tradeRequest: We bestow you the honor of this trade offer.
startBias.denounced: Every bee in my hive shrivels in disgust at the thought of you.
